summary: Apply Greptile review polish for local reads, analytics memory use, and auth source handling.
rationale: The generated Outreach package opened local read paths through the read-write migration opener, grouped analytics after materialising all records, let AuthHeader mutate AuthSource while acting as a getter, and let MCP SQL results bypass the advertised item/byte caps. These changes align local reads with the MCP read-only path, stream group-by rows, keep AuthHeader side-effect free, and bound MCP SQL output.
